list.name: location
list.label: Lieu
list.query: SELECT CASE location WHEN 'LAN' THEN 'Sur place (LAN)' ELSE 'À distance (online)' END AS __text, location AS __value FROM streamer_v WHERE location IS NOT NULL GROUP BY location ORDER BY location
list.definition: SELECT CASE location WHEN 'LAN' THEN 'Sur place (LAN)' ELSE 'À distance (online)' END AS __text, location AS __value FROM streamer_v WHERE location IS NOT NULL GROUP BY location ORDER BY location

list.name: streamer
list.label: Streamer
list.query: SELECT display AS __text, twitch_id AS __value FROM streamer_v st WHERE coalesce(st.location, '') ~ '^(${location:regex})$' ORDER BY lower(display)
list.definition: SELECT display AS __text, twitch_id AS __value FROM streamer_v st WHERE coalesce(st.location, '') ~ '^(${location:regex})$' ORDER BY lower(display)

target.rawSql: WITH m AS (SELECT ts, floor(max(donation_total) OVER (ORDER BY ts) / 1e6) AS mil FROM snapshot WHERE $__timeFilter(ts)), c AS (SELECT ts, mil, lag(mil) OVER (ORDER BY ts) AS prev FROM m) SELECT ts AS time, mil::int || ' M€' AS text FROM c WHERE prev IS NOT NULL AND mil > prev ORDER BY ts

panels.title: Total final de l'événement

targets.rawSql: SELECT replace(replace(to_char(donation_total, 'FM999,999,999.00'), ',', ' '), '.', ',') || ' €' FROM snapshot WHERE ts <= '2026-09-06T23:12:00.000Z'::timestamptz ORDER BY ts DESC LIMIT 1

panels.description: Total de l'événement à la fin de l'événement avant la fin des dons, le lundi 7 septembre à 01h11 (heure de Paris).

panels.title: Dons sans streamer

targets.rawSql: SELECT sn.donation_total - sum(s.donation_total) FROM snapshot sn JOIN streamer_sample_v s USING (ts) WHERE NOT s.derived AND sn.ts = (SELECT max(ts) FROM snapshot WHERE ts <= '2026-09-06T23:12:00.000Z'::timestamptz) GROUP BY sn.donation_total

panels.description: Tous les dons qui n'ont pas pu être rattachés à un streamer : le total de l'événement moins la somme des compteurs des streamers. On y trouve les dons faits sans choisir de streamer (la page d'équipe Streamlabs Charity sans membre), les billets du concert de jeudi, tous les dons de la boutique, etc.

panels.title: Il manque pour doubler 2025

targets.rawSql: SELECT 33317320 - donation_total FROM snapshot WHERE ts <= '2026-09-06T23:12:00.000Z'::timestamptz ORDER BY ts DESC LIMIT 1

panels.description: Écart entre le total actuel et le double du total de 2025, soit 33 317 320 €.

panels.title: Viewers moyens

targets.rawSql: SELECT coalesce(avg(v), 0) FROM (  SELECT s.ts, sum(s.viewers) AS v FROM streamer_sample_v s JOIN streamer_v st USING (twitch_id)  WHERE $__timeFilter(s.ts) AND NOT st.derived AND s.twitch_id IN ($streamer) AND coalesce(st.location, '') ~ '^(${location:regex})$'  GROUP BY s.ts) x

panels.description: Viewers cumulés des streamers correspondant aux filtres Lieu et Streamer, en moyenne sur les relevés de la plage de temps sélectionnée.

panels.title: Pic de viewers

targets.rawSql: SELECT coalesce(max(v), 0) FROM (  SELECT s.ts, sum(s.viewers) AS v FROM streamer_sample_v s JOIN streamer_v st USING (twitch_id)  WHERE $__timeFilter(s.ts) AND NOT st.derived AND s.twitch_id IN ($streamer) AND coalesce(st.location, '') ~ '^(${location:regex})$'  GROUP BY s.ts) x

panels.description: Plus grand nombre de viewers cumulés des streamers correspondant aux filtres Lieu et Streamer, dans la plage de temps sélectionnée.

panels.title: Streamers

targets.rawSql: SELECT count(DISTINCT s.twitch_id) FILTER (WHERE s.online) AS "Passés en live", count(DISTINCT s.twitch_id) AS "Inscrits" FROM streamer_sample_v s JOIN streamer_v st USING (twitch_id) WHERE $__timeFilter(s.ts) AND NOT st.derived AND s.twitch_id IN ($streamer) AND coalesce(st.location, '') ~ '^(${location:regex})$'

panels.description: Streamers correspondant aux filtres Lieu et Streamer : ceux passés en live au moins une fois dans la plage de temps sélectionnée, et tous ceux listés par l'API.

panels.title: Heures visionnées

targets.rawSql: SELECT coalesce(sum(x.viewers * least(x.gap_s, 300)), 0) / 3600.0 FROM streamer_sample_v x JOIN streamer_v st USING (twitch_id) WHERE $__timeFilter(x.ts) AND NOT st.derived AND x.twitch_id IN ($streamer) AND coalesce(st.location, '') ~ '^(${location:regex})$' AND x.gap_s IS NOT NULL

panels.description: La taille de l'audience dans le temps, en heures visionnées par viewer : le nombre de viewers des streamers correspondant aux filtres Lieu et Streamer, additionné minute par minute sur la période sélectionnée (chaque relevé compte le temps écoulé depuis le précédent, plafonné à 5 minutes pour que les trous dans les données ne comptent pas). Un viewer qui regarde pendant une heure vaut une heure visionnée par un viewer ; 1 000 viewers pendant 2 heures font 2 000 heures visionnées par viewer.

panels.title: Heures de stream

targets.rawSql: SELECT coalesce(sum(least(s.gap_s, 300)) FILTER (WHERE s.online), 0) / 3600.0 FROM streamer_sample_v s JOIN streamer_v st USING (twitch_id) WHERE NOT st.derived AND coalesce(st.location, '') ~ '^(${location:regex})$' AND $__timeFilter(s.ts) AND s.twitch_id IN ($streamer) AND s.gap_s IS NOT NULL

panels.description: Temps total en live, additionné sur les streamers correspondant aux filtres Lieu et Streamer, dans la plage de temps sélectionnée. Chaque relevé en live compte la minute écoulée depuis le relevé précédent (plafonnée à 5 minutes, pour que les trous dans les données ne comptent pas).

panels.title: Dons par heure visionnée par viewer

targets.rawSql: WITH g AS (  SELECT s.twitch_id, sum(s.gain) AS gained FROM streamer_sample_v s  WHERE $__timeFilter(s.ts) AND s.gain IS NOT NULL GROUP BY s.twitch_id) , v AS (  SELECT sum(x.viewers * least(x.gap_s, 300)) / 3600.0 AS viewer_hours  FROM streamer_sample_v x JOIN streamer_v st USING (twitch_id)  WHERE $__timeFilter(x.ts) AND NOT st.derived AND x.twitch_id IN ($streamer) AND coalesce(st.location, '') ~ '^(${location:regex})$' AND x.gap_s IS NOT NULL) SELECT (SELECT coalesce(sum(g.gained), 0) FROM g JOIN streamer_v st USING (twitch_id)         WHERE NOT st.derived AND g.twitch_id IN ($streamer) AND coalesce(st.location, '') ~ '^(${location:regex})$') / nullif(v.viewer_hours, 0) FROM v

panels.description: Ce que la communauté donne par rapport à sa taille : les dons gagnés par les streamers correspondant aux filtres Lieu et Streamer sur la période sélectionnée, divisés par leurs heures visionnées par viewer (le nombre de viewers additionné minute par minute sur la même période, en heures). Un viewer qui regarde pendant une heure vaut une heure visionnée par un viewer : 5 € signifie 5 € récoltés pour chaque heure regardée par un viewer. Les dons sans streamer (billets, boutique, anonymes) ne sont pas comptés.

panels.title: Total des dons au fil du temps
panels.description: En pointillés, le total final des éditions précédentes (depuis 2019).

targets.rawSql: SELECT ts AS time, viewers_total AS "Viewers" FROM snapshot WHERE $__timeFilter(ts) ORDER BY 1

SELECT $__timeGroupAlias(ts, $__interval), sum(delta) AS "Dons" FROM (  SELECT ts, donation_total - lag(donation_total) OVER (ORDER BY ts) AS delta  FROM snapshot WHERE $__timeFilter(ts)) d WHERE delta IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
SELECT ts AS time, streamers_online AS "En live" FROM snapshot WHERE $__timeFilter(ts) ORDER BY 1

WITH h AS (  SELECT s.twitch_id, sum(least(s.gap_s, 300)) FILTER (WHERE s.online) / 3600.0 AS hours  FROM streamer_sample_v s WHERE $__timeFilter(s.ts) AND s.gap_s IS NOT NULL GROUP BY s.twitch_id) , cur AS (  SELECT twitch_id, donation_total, viewers, online FROM streamer_sample_v  WHERE ts = (SELECT max(ts) FROM snapshot WHERE ts <= '2026-09-06T23:12:00.000Z'::timestamptz)), pk AS (  SELECT twitch_id, max(viewers) AS peak FROM streamer_sample_v WHERE $__timeFilter(ts) GROUP BY twitch_id) SELECT st.profile_url AS "Avatar", st.display AS "Streamer", cur.donation_total AS "Cagnotte", coalesce(pk.peak, 0) AS "Pic de viewers", coalesce(h.hours, 0) AS "Heures de stream", st.login AS login FROM cur JOIN streamer_v st USING (twitch_id) LEFT JOIN h USING (twitch_id) LEFT JOIN pk USING (twitch_id) WHERE true AND coalesce(st.location, '') ~ '^(${location:regex})$' ORDER BY cur.donation_total DESC LIMIT 25

WITH h AS (  SELECT s.twitch_id, sum(least(s.gap_s, 300)) FILTER (WHERE s.online) / 3600.0 AS hours  FROM streamer_sample_v s WHERE $__timeFilter(s.ts) AND s.gap_s IS NOT NULL GROUP BY s.twitch_id) , cur AS (  SELECT twitch_id, donation_total, viewers, online FROM streamer_sample_v  WHERE ts = (SELECT max(ts) FROM snapshot WHERE ts <= '2026-09-06T23:12:00.000Z'::timestamptz)), pk AS (  SELECT twitch_id, max(viewers) AS peak FROM streamer_sample_v WHERE $__timeFilter(ts) GROUP BY twitch_id) , v AS (SELECT x.twitch_id, sum(x.viewers * least(x.gap_s, 300)) / 3600.0 AS vh         FROM streamer_sample_v x WHERE $__timeFilter(x.ts) AND x.gap_s IS NOT NULL GROUP BY x.twitch_id) SELECT st.profile_url AS "Avatar", st.display AS "Streamer", round(v.vh) AS "Heures visionnées", cur.donation_total AS "Cagnotte", coalesce(pk.peak, 0) AS "Pic de viewers", coalesce(h.hours, 0) AS "Heures de stream", st.login AS login FROM cur JOIN streamer_v st USING (twitch_id) LEFT JOIN h USING (twitch_id) LEFT JOIN pk USING (twitch_id) JOIN v USING (twitch_id) WHERE true AND coalesce(st.location, '') ~ '^(${location:regex})$' ORDER BY v.vh DESC LIMIT 25

panels.title: Top des gains sur la période

targets.rawSql: WITH h AS (  SELECT s.twitch_id, sum(least(s.gap_s, 300)) FILTER (WHERE s.online) / 3600.0 AS hours  FROM streamer_sample_v s WHERE $__timeFilter(s.ts) AND s.gap_s IS NOT NULL GROUP BY s.twitch_id) , cur AS (  SELECT twitch_id, donation_total, viewers, online FROM streamer_sample_v  WHERE ts = (SELECT max(ts) FROM snapshot WHERE ts <= '2026-09-06T23:12:00.000Z'::timestamptz)), pk AS (  SELECT twitch_id, max(viewers) AS peak FROM streamer_sample_v WHERE $__timeFilter(ts) GROUP BY twitch_id) , g AS (  SELECT s.twitch_id, sum(s.gain) AS gained FROM streamer_sample_v s  WHERE $__timeFilter(s.ts) AND s.gain IS NOT NULL GROUP BY s.twitch_id) SELECT st.profile_url AS "Avatar", st.display AS "Streamer", g.gained AS "Gagné", cur.donation_total AS "Cagnotte", coalesce(pk.peak, 0) AS "Pic de viewers", coalesce(h.hours, 0) AS "Heures de stream", st.login AS login FROM cur JOIN streamer_v st USING (twitch_id) LEFT JOIN h USING (twitch_id) LEFT JOIN pk USING (twitch_id) JOIN g USING (twitch_id) WHERE true AND coalesce(st.location, '') ~ '^(${location:regex})$' ORDER BY g.gained DESC LIMIT 25

panels.title: Top des heures de stream sur la période

targets.rawSql: WITH h AS (  SELECT s.twitch_id, sum(least(s.gap_s, 300)) FILTER (WHERE s.online) / 3600.0 AS hours  FROM streamer_sample_v s WHERE $__timeFilter(s.ts) AND s.gap_s IS NOT NULL GROUP BY s.twitch_id) , cur AS (  SELECT twitch_id, donation_total, viewers, online FROM streamer_sample_v  WHERE ts = (SELECT max(ts) FROM snapshot WHERE ts <= '2026-09-06T23:12:00.000Z'::timestamptz)), pk AS (  SELECT twitch_id, max(viewers) AS peak FROM streamer_sample_v WHERE $__timeFilter(ts) GROUP BY twitch_id) SELECT st.profile_url AS "Avatar", st.display AS "Streamer", cur.donation_total AS "Cagnotte", coalesce(pk.peak, 0) AS "Pic de viewers", coalesce(h.hours, 0) AS "Heures de stream", st.login AS login FROM cur JOIN streamer_v st USING (twitch_id) LEFT JOIN h USING (twitch_id) LEFT JOIN pk USING (twitch_id) WHERE true AND coalesce(st.location, '') ~ '^(${location:regex})$' ORDER BY coalesce(h.hours, 0) DESC, cur.donation_total DESC LIMIT 25

panels.title: Top des pics de viewers sur la période

targets.rawSql: WITH pk AS (  SELECT s.twitch_id, max(s.viewers) AS peak FROM streamer_sample_v s  WHERE $__timeFilter(s.ts) AND NOT s.derived AND s.twitch_id IN ($streamer) GROUP BY s.twitch_id), cur AS (  SELECT twitch_id, viewers, donation_total FROM streamer_sample_v WHERE ts = (SELECT max(ts) FROM snapshot WHERE ts <= '2026-09-06T23:12:00.000Z'::timestamptz)), top AS (  SELECT pk.twitch_id, pk.peak FROM pk JOIN streamer_v st USING (twitch_id) WHERE pk.peak > 0 AND coalesce(st.location, '') ~ '^(${location:regex})$'  ORDER BY pk.peak DESC LIMIT 25) SELECT st.profile_url AS "Avatar", st.display AS "Streamer", top.peak AS "Pic de viewers",        (SELECT min(x.ts) FROM streamer_sample_v x WHERE x.twitch_id = top.twitch_id AND x.viewers = top.peak         AND $__timeFilter(x.ts)) AS "Atteint à", cur.viewers AS "Viewers", cur.donation_total AS "Cagnotte", st.login AS login FROM top JOIN streamer_v st USING (twitch_id) LEFT JOIN cur USING (twitch_id) ORDER BY top.peak DESC

panels.description: Plus grand nombre de viewers atteint par chaque streamer dans la plage de temps sélectionnée, et le moment où il l'a atteint. Suit les filtres Lieu et Streamer.

panels.title: Top des viewers moyens en live sur la période

targets.rawSql: WITH v AS (  SELECT x.twitch_id, sum(x.viewers * least(x.gap_s, 300)) / 3600.0 AS viewer_hours, sum(least(x.gap_s, 300)) FILTER (WHERE x.online) / 3600.0 AS hours  FROM streamer_sample_v x WHERE $__timeFilter(x.ts) AND NOT x.derived AND x.twitch_id IN ($streamer) AND x.gap_s IS NOT NULL  GROUP BY x.twitch_id), cur AS (  SELECT twitch_id, viewers, donation_total FROM streamer_sample_v WHERE ts = (SELECT max(ts) FROM snapshot WHERE ts <= '2026-09-06T23:12:00.000Z'::timestamptz)) SELECT st.profile_url AS "Avatar", st.display AS "Streamer", round(v.viewer_hours / v.hours) AS "Viewers moyens", v.hours AS "Heures de stream", cur.viewers AS "Viewers", cur.donation_total AS "Cagnotte", st.login AS login FROM v JOIN streamer_v st USING (twitch_id) LEFT JOIN cur USING (twitch_id) WHERE v.hours >= 1 AND coalesce(st.location, '') ~ '^(${location:regex})$' ORDER BY 3 DESC LIMIT 25

panels.description: Heures visionnées divisées par les heures en live sur la plage de temps sélectionnée : l'audience habituelle du streamer quand il est en live. Streamers avec au moins une heure de live. Suit les filtres Lieu et Streamer.
